notes.title: v.1.0.3 - Little Fixes
notes.content:
Just a little update mainly to fix the volume controls, which some newbie gamedev bewilderingly did not properly test before releasing his game... can you believe that guy? 

v.1.0.3 changelog:

[list]
[*]     fixed volume controls not working properly (broken by dynamic music)
[*]     fixed a bug where camera would sometimes snap to Fyo in the woods instead of pan
[*]     tweaked sounds in Seer's house to accommodate fixed volume controls
[*]     very small tweak to ending dialogue
[/list]
Thanks once again to everyone for your support; all your comments and reviews have been incredibly helpful and have me more excited than ever to plan out my next project.

Talk to everyone again soon!
